title: Release target (was pass) and an owner-set wave inside it
lead: Rename "pass" to "release target" everywhere a person or agent reads it, keeping `--pass`, the `pass` JSON field and `by_pass` as deprecated aliases, and add an owner-set wave: a number within an item's release target that list, roadmap render and the TUI group by. `plan-parallel` keeps computing parallel sets from dependencies and Files paths, and flags an item planned in an earlier wave than its dependency.
findings_note: Owner 2026-11-04 (interview in the ork session): rename pass to release target, and add a wave so mini slices can target a version release and that release can be split into waves to execute. Owner decisions: (1) the stored wave is an owner label, a number within an item's release target, like pass today; plan-parallel (s376, s377) keeps computing what can run in parallel from dependencies and Files paths and works inside one wave; docs must name the two apart (planned wave vs parallel set). (2) The release target is the main name (flag --release-target, JSON field release_target, by_release_target in stats); --pass, the pass field and by_pass keep working as aliases with a deprecation note; existing keys (v1.1, v1.20) stay unchanged. Spec step to confirm: the flag name for the wave (for example --wave N), how list, move, render, roadmap and TUI group by release target then wave, whether items with no wave sort last, and how plan-parallel treats an item whose dependency sits in a later wave (flag it). Acceptance: (1) slicer add/set accept --release-target and --wave N; --pass still works and prints one deprecation note; (2) JSON output carries release_target and wave, and still carries pass as an alias; (3) list, roadmap render and the TUI group by release target, then wave, and show the wave; (4) plan-parallel output is unchanged for items without a wave, and flags an item scheduled in an earlier wave than its dependency; (5) existing .slicer data loads unchanged, with a test that loads a fixture holding only pass; (6) slicer check is clean and the docs and ai instructions use the new words. Follow-up: ork reads release target and wave (see the ork slice filed with this one).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** changing existing release-target keys (`v1.1`, `v1.20` stay); computing waves automatically; ork's reading of release target and wave (the ork slice filed with this one); removing the `pass` aliases.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Owner 2026-11-04 (interview in the ork session): rename pass to release target, and add a wave so mini slices can target a version release and that release can be split into waves to execute. Owner decisions:

1. The stored wave is an owner label, a number within an item's release target, like pass today. `plan-parallel` (s376, s377) keeps computing what can run in parallel from dependencies and Files paths and works inside one wave. Docs must name the two apart (planned wave vs parallel set).
2. The release target is the main name: flag `--release-target`, JSON field `release_target`, `by_release_target` in stats. `--pass`, the `pass` field and `by_pass` keep working as aliases with a deprecation note.

What the code shows (read 2026-11-06):

- The field is `Item.pass_key` (`src/slicer/model.py:312`), stored as `fields.pass` (`:408`, read at `:445`); declared groups are `Index.passes` with `pass_info`, `pass_keys` and `undeclared_pass_keys` (`:757-787`). Index schema is `SCHEMA_VERSION = 11` (`:17`).
- `--pass` appears on `list` (`src/slicer/cli_parser.py:376`), `add` (`:448`) and `set` (`:481`); the outline key is `pass` (`src/slicer/outline.py:41`, `:104`, `:246`); stats emits `by_pass` (`src/slicer/cli_common.py:642`, text at `src/slicer/cli_report.py:161`).
- Grouping: roadmap render groups by `pass_keys()` (`src/slicer/render.py:318-335`); list adds a PASS column (`src/slicer/cli_queue.py:524-558`) and filters at `:629`; ranking puts declared pass order before score (`src/slicer/graph.py:190-231`); the TUI has a `pass` filter group and field (`src/slicer/tui.py:125`, `:681`, `:715`, `:775`).
- `plan-parallel` (`src/slicer/queries.py:437-520`) already calls its output "waves" (`ParallelPlan.waves`, JSON key `waves`, text in `src/slicer/cli_queue.py:463-496`). That word now collides with the owner's wave; the docs and help must keep them apart.
- "pass" appears in `src/slicer/ai.py` (41 lines, many of them the unrelated "one pass"), `docs/agents.md` (33), `docs/tui.md` (11), `docs/working-with-agents.md` (8), `docs/import.md` (7) and others; only the field meaning changes.

Open owner question 1: the wave flag and field name.

- (a) `--wave N`, JSON `wave` (integer or null).
- (b) `--release-wave N`, JSON `release_wave`, so it reads as part of the release target.

Recommendation: (a), short and matching the owner's word.

Open owner question 2: how list, roadmap render and the TUI show waves.

- (a) Group by release target, then a sub-group per wave (`### Wave 1` in the roadmap; a WAVE column in list; a wave filter in the TUI).
- (b) No sub-groups: a WAVE column in list and the roadmap tables, and items within a release target ordered by wave, then the current order.

Recommendation: (a) for the roadmap, (b)'s column for list, so list stays one table.

Open owner question 3: where items with no wave sort within a release target.

- (a) Last, after every numbered wave.
- (b) First, as "unplanned".

Recommendation: (a); unplanned work comes after planned waves.

Open owner question 4: how `plan-parallel` treats an item whose dependency sits in a later wave.

- (a) Report it in a new `wave_conflicts` list (`{id, wave, depends_on, depends_wave}`) and place both as today.
- (b) Hold the item back (`blocked`, reason `after_wave: ID`) until its dependency's wave.
- (c) Only `slicer check` warns; `plan-parallel` is unchanged.

Recommendation: (a), plus the same line as a `check` warning; nothing is silently reordered.

Open owner question 5 (found while speccing): the stored shape.

- (a) Keep the stored key `fields.pass`; add `fields.wave` only when set, so an index with no waves is byte-identical and no schema bump is needed.
- (b) Rename the stored key to `fields.release_target` with a schema bump and a load-time migration of `pass`.

Recommendation: (a); acceptance asks that existing data load unchanged, and stored JSON is not a person-facing name.

The slice is size L, effort 3. Splitting it into two slices, (1) the rename with aliases and (2) the wave field, grouping and plan-parallel flag, would let each land on its own; that is the owner's call.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `test_Add_ReleaseTargetAndWave_StoredAndShownInJson` (`tests/test_add_options.py`): `add --release-target v1.20 --wave 2 --json` returns `release_target: "v1.20"`, `pass: "v1.20"` and `wave: 2`. Fails first: unknown flags.
- `test_Set_PassAlias_WorksAndPrintsOneDeprecationNote` (`tests/test_add_options.py`): `set ID --pass v1.20` sets the release target and stderr has exactly one deprecation line naming `--release-target`. Fails first: no note.
- `test_Set_WaveNotAPositiveInteger_IsUsage`: `--wave 0` and `--wave x` exit 2 with code `usage` and write nothing.
- `test_Load_IndexWithOnlyPass_LoadsUnchangedAndRoundTrips` (`tests/test_schema.py`): a fixture index holding only `fields.pass` loads, `release_target` equals it, `wave` is null, and a write with no change leaves the bytes identical (under question 5 option a).
- `test_Stats_ByReleaseTarget_AndByPassAlias` (`tests/test_add_options.py` or the stats test module): both keys present with equal counts.
- `test_List_GroupsByReleaseTargetThenWave_NoWaveLast` (`tests/test_list_pass_order.py`): per questions 2 and 3.
- `test_Render_Roadmap_ShowsWaveWithinReleaseTarget` (`tests/test_render.py`): per question 2.
- `test_TuiFilter_WaveGroup_FiltersItems` (`tests/test_tui.py`).
- `test_PlanParallel_NoWaves_OutputUnchanged` (`tests/test_plan_parallel.py`): the JSON for a fixture with no waves equals the pre-change JSON byte for byte. Guard.
- `test_PlanParallel_ItemInEarlierWaveThanDependency_IsFlagged` (`tests/test_plan_parallel.py`): per question 4. Fails first.
- `test_Outline_ReleaseTargetAndWaveKeys_Import` (`tests/test_outline.py`): an outline with `release_target:` and `wave:` imports; one with `pass:` still does.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Get the owner's answers to questions 1-5 (and on splitting).
2. Tests first; confirm each fails (or the guard passes) for the reason given.
3. Model and storage per question 5; JSON output adds `release_target` next to `pass` and `wave` after it, in a fixed key order.
4. CLI flags and outline keys with aliases; the deprecation note is printed once per command, on stderr, never in JSON stdout.
5. Grouping and ordering in list, render, ranking and the TUI per questions 2 and 3.
6. `plan-parallel` per question 4; keep its JSON key `waves` and its output for wave-less items unchanged.
7. Docs, `ai instructions` text and CHANGELOG use "release target" and "wave", and say once that a planned wave is the owner's label while `plan-parallel` computes parallel sets.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `python3 -m unittest tests.test_add_options tests.test_list_pass_order tests.test_plan_parallel tests.test_render tests.test_outline tests.test_schema -v` passes.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests` passes; `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m slicer check` passes; `git diff --check` prints nothing.
- `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m slicer render` on this repository with no waves set leaves `git diff --stat .slicer/index.json` empty (stored data unchanged under question 5 option a).
- `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m slicer ai instructions | rg -n "release target"` finds the new words.
- [HUMAN CHECK] `slicer list` and the roadmap render show items grouped by release target, then wave, with the wave visible; `slicer tui` offers a wave filter.

sections.body: One commit on the slice branch: "release target and wave: rename pass, add an owner-set wave".
